title: Fix retry-of-retry losing the original request; answer study M1 review 1
summary: Retrying a rejected job whose own request was "try again on <job>" must still show the reader the original request, not just the retry phrase. The reader's brief and findings must come from the retried job. Also answer review 1 of the study capability M1 design in the design doc. This redoes the rejected attempt with the same scope, and fixes the three review notes: CHANGELOG heading, a refusal test, and a test that A and B give distinct verdicts.

defaults_applied.how: The fix gets lifecycle and unit tests; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Behavior criteria cite exact cargo commands the verifier can run.
One focused fix plus the review answer; no other refactors.
The design answer and changelog entries are written for an outside reader.
'Review 1' was resolved from the repo to the study M1 design review.

assumptions: 'Get review 1 answered' means the study capability M1 design (docs/design/study-capability-m1.md) gets a written answer to the 7 major findings of its review 1. That review exists but the design does not respond to it.

The fix: when the retried job's own request is itself a 'try again on <job>' form, the carried request is resolved to the original job's request, with the retried job's findings kept. Walking the chain is bounded and cycle-safe.
The earlier rejection was mainly a verification-evidence failure (cited test commands not seen running), so the producer must run each cited command exactly as written, with no extra shell suffix.
question: By 'get review 1 answered', do you mean a written response to the seven major findings in docs/design/study-capability-m1.md? I assumed yes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A lifecycle test named retrying_a_retry_carries_the_original_request_redacted exists and passes. Job A is rejected, job B ("try again on A") is rejected, then "try again on B" is asked. The reader brief for the third job contains A's original request (redacted) and B's findings. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle retrying_a_retry

The retry-of-retry test uses a different verdict for A and for B, so the assertion that the findings come from B (and not A) can fail. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle retrying_a_retry

The existing try-again tests still pass: a landed or unknown job is refused and commits nothing, and a plain retry shows the earlier attempt. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle try_again
A test covers the bare "try again on" request, which is refused with the 'say which job' message. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-core earlier_attempt
The reader-brief rendering tests still pass. Run: cargo test --locked -p athena-context reader_brief
Formatting and lints are clean. Run: cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] records the retry-of-retry fix in a '### Fixed' section placed after '### Added', so the existing review-1 bullet stays under '### Added'.

docs/design/study-capability-m1.md answers each of review 1's seven major findings (M1 to M7), saying accepted or declined with the revision made. Its status line says review 1 is answered. The review file itself is unchanged.

out_of_scope: Redesigning the study capability beyond answering the review's findings
Changing governance files or verifier evidence matching
departures: Cost is higher than the reference because the work includes a code fix, several tests and a design-doc answer to seven major findings, and the earlier attempt was rejected.
